verdict.rationale: Penpot docs explicitly claim CSS Grid and Flex layout support for responsive/rules-based design (penpot-docs-14), but the evidence pack lacks detailed documentation of auto-layout resizing behavior, constraint-based resizing rules, or how these interact across board resizing — only a single marketing line addresses this directly. Community evidence is silent on auto-layout/constraints specifically, and several comments note general performance/stability issues with complex files that could affect responsive layout usability at scale (penpot-comm-10, penpot-comm-19). Missing for 10: dedicated docs/tutorials on constraints and grid/flex resizing behavior, hands-on validation that auto layout resizes designs the way real UIs flex, and independent corroboration of this specific feature.
